recentItems.title: Imran Khan's Lawyers' BIG claim: Actor was passing through Nana Chowk; Didn't join anti-CEC protest!
recentItems.description:
Bollywood actor Imran Khan is preparing to challenge the notice asking him to leave India by October 28. The actor, who is a US citizen and an Overseas Citizen of India cardholder, will contest the order issued by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office. According to his lawyers, the notice is being challenged because no law or rule prohibits an OCI cardholder from participating in a protest. Watch the video.
